headline: ED 🍔 SHEERAN 🧑‍🎤 BLAMES 🍋 Promoters 🏦 For DROPPING 🍑 Macklemore 🎤
text:
ED 🍔 SHEERAN 🧑‍🎤 just DROPPED 🍑 a statement 📜 claiming it was NOT ❌ his call 📞 to boot 👢 Macklemore 🎤 from the tour 🚌 after that whole messy 🍝 pro Palestine 🇵🇸 drama 🔥!! Robert 🍝 Kraft 🏟️ the stadium 🍔 daddy who owns 🏠 Gillette 🏈 Stadium 🏟️ says Sheeran 🧑‍🎤 rang him up 📱 BEFORE ⏰ Macklemore 🎤 even challenged 🚨 him to match 💰 that one million 💵 donation 🪙 for aid 🚑 in the region 🌍 to fight this humanitarian 😢 crisis ⚠️!! Kraft 🏟️ wrote ✍️ that Ed 🍔 asked him to commit 💍 two million 💰 to match his own donation 🪙 and now plans 📍 to hit up 📞 other venue owners 🏠 so they can keep building 🧱 bridges 🌉 together 🤝!! The whole thing got railed 💦 into controversy 🔥 after Macklemore 🎤 performed his pro Palestine 🇵🇸 song 🎵 calling out genocide 😱 in Gaza 🏜️ which Israel 🇮🇱 rejects 🙅 while insisting it wasn't shade ☀️ at his Jewish brothers 👬 and sisters 👭!! Some bystander on the internet 🌐 was like bro 🧔 this is getting cooked 🍳 way too fast 🏃‍♂️ but Ed 🍔 just wants to keep the fans 👥 and crew 👷 happy 😊 without cancelling the whole tour 🚌!!

KRAFT 🏟️ dropped his second statement 📜 this week 📅 confirming he banned 🚫 Macklemore 🎤 from performing 🎤 at Sheeran's shows 🎸 in Gillette 🏈 Stadium 🏟️ because the Jewish 🕍 owner accused him of hate speech 🗣️ during two prior support slots 🎟️ where the rapper kept yelling FREE 🇵🇸 PALESTINE 🕌 and flashing Gaza 🏜️ images 🖼️!! Macklemore 🎤 also performed a whole song 🎵 dedicated to the protesters ✊ and referred to genocide 😱 which sparked the backlash 🔥 leading to other support acts quitting 🚪 in protest 🙅‍♂️!! Ed 🍔 Sheeran 🧑‍🎤 insists the decision was made by his promoters 🏦 at Messina Touring Group 🚌 not by him personally 👤 and they warned that some venues 🏟️ would straight up refuse 🚫 the concerts 🎤 if Macklemore 🎤 stayed on the bill 📋 meaning the entire tour 🚌 would get cancelled 🛑!! Sheeran 🧑‍🎤 who once played 🎸 at Kraft's 🏟️ wedding 💒 in twenty twenty two 📅 has faced heat 🔥 for apparently accepting the decision 🙇 but he says he respects Macklemore's 🎤 strength 💪 of purpose to stand up 🧍 and shout 📢 for what he believes 🙏 while admitting he doesn't use his own platform 📣 for politics 🗳️ yet still cares ❤️ in his personal way 🛤️!!

SHEERAN 🧑‍🎤 is now in full damage 🚨 control mode 🛠️ after the backlash 🔥 made his other support acts like Finneas 👦 brother of Billie Eilish 👩‍🎤 plus Aaron Rowe 🎸 Lukas Graham 🎤 and Irish band Beoga 🍀 all quit 🚪 in solidarity 🤝 with Macklemore 🎤!! Those artists argued the removal represented a chilling ❄️ effect on free speech 🗣️ and even Ireland's Classic Hits Radio 📻 dropped Ed's 🍔 music 🎵 after listener reactions 😡!! Macklemore 🎤 clapped back 📣 on Wednesday 📅 saying he would donate the entire one million 💰 of his net earnings 💵 from the Loop Tour 🌀 to six Palestinian organisations 🕌 to bring the conversation back where it belongs 🗣️ to the Palestinian people 🇵🇸!! He called it a manmade injustice ⚖️ that requires immediate political change 🗳️ and insisted his free Palestine 🇵🇸 call was never an attack on Jewish people 🕍!! Meanwhile Kraft 🏟️ claims he has supported efforts to create opportunity 🚪 for Palestinians 🇵🇸 and has worked to bring young Palestinians 👦 and Israelis 🇮🇱 together to build businesses 🏢 create jobs 💼 and forge relationships 🤝!!

THE 🏟️ billionaire Kraft 🏟️ who owns the Kraft Group 🏪 accused Macklemore 🎤 of having a broader history 📜 of antisemitic rhetoric 🗣️ which the Grammy winner 🏆 denies 🚫 while also saying the rapper was only sharing selective information 📋 and ignoring the actions of Hamas ⚠️!! Kraft 🏟️ added that he has dedicated much of his life ⏳ to building bridges 🌉 between all people 👥 and believes deeply that all lives 🧬 are worth protecting 🛡️!! Ed 🍔 Sheeran 🧑‍🎤 who is able to perform solo 🎸 even if his setlist 📋 has to be reconfigured 🔄 to compensate for losing Beoga 🍀 still doesn't want to let down his fans 👥 or crew 👷 by cancelling the tour 🚌 which resumes in Philadelphia 🏙️ this Saturday 📅!! Some artists like Billy Bragg 🎤 have called for him to scrap 🗑️ the whole thing but that could leave Ed 🍔 and his promoters 🏦 liable for massive costs 💰 including venue hire 🏟️ and ticket refunds 🎟️!! The promoters 🏦 explained that keeping Macklemore 🎤 would have forced venues 🏟️ like Gillette 🏈 to pull out 🚫 meaning the entire US leg 🦵 of the tour 🚌 would collapse 🏚️!!

ED 🍔 now plans 📍 to reach out 📞 to other venue owners 🏠 with the goal of continuing to work 🤝 together to build more bridges 🌉 while Kraft 🏟️ still hasn't confirmed if he actually dropped the two million 💰 donation 🪙 or exactly where those funds would go 🏦!! This marks the first time anyone suggested Sheeran 🧑‍🎤 had pledged that sum himself 🧾 and the ginger singer 🧑‍🎤 hasn't commented on any donation 🪙 or other philanthropic plans 📋 at all!! The musician 🎸 faced criticism 🔥 from some corners for his apparent acceptance of the ban 🚫 but he maintains the call wasn't his to make 📞 and he just wants to avoid disappointing the crowd 👥 who bought tickets 🎟️!! Macklemore 🎤 performed at two previous support slots 🎤 before getting removed and used those moments to push his message 🗣️ which Kraft 🏟️ labeled as hate speech 🗣️ sparking the whole messy 🍝 chain reaction ⚗️ that left multiple acts walking 🚪 and radio stations dropping tracks 🎵!! In the end everyone is edging 😣 toward some kind of resolution 🤝 but the tour 🚌 keeps rolling 🎲 with Ed 🍔 going solo 🎸 and the conversation still raging 🔥 about free speech 🗣️ aid 🚑 and bridges 🌉 that need building 🛠️!!
